<thought>The mass spectrum shows a classic carbon isotopic distribution: a dominant M peak, an M+1 peak at ~17.5% (consistent with ~16‑18 carbons), and rapidly decreasing M+2, M+3, etc. No other distinct isotope patterns (e.g., Cl, Br, S) are evident. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
